[Scene: A conversation scrolls steadily down the screen.]
An AI agent works through a long conversation, using what it has said and learned along the way.

[Scene: The scroll reaches a limit; older messages fade.]
But the conversation can grow too large for the model’s window—the amount it can keep in view at once.

[Scene: The conversation folds into a short note.]
To keep working, the agent compresses the conversation into a summary.

[Scene: The agent continues, reading the summary.]
The summary carries key information forward, so work can continue from there.

[Scene: A small detail disappears as the summary forms.]
But anything left out of the summary is gone from the agent’s view. It may no longer know a detail, even if it appeared earlier in the conversation.

[Scene: The agent is asked about earlier work, then checks the summary.]
A good summary needs a check: ask the agent questions about the old work. If it can answer accurately, the summary preserved what matters. If it can’t, the missing details need attention before work moves on.
